args.body: Reuse TASK-179560980110 and TASK-179560980111 for WORDPRESS-MIGRATION-QA-PAID-PILOT. The original RSL brief is saved at products/services/wordpress-migration-qa-pilot/raw/rsl-project.html. It describes a C$2,000–$2,500 fixed-price build of roughly six pages from completed storyboards, with mandatory Gutenberg, Kadence Theme and Kadence Blocks. It invites applications for the build. Count this as one original brief within the existing allowance. Reuse any qualifying evidence already obtained. Otherwise use a remaining slot only for an original with a concrete standalone migration QA signal. If the scope falls short, read back the bounded result and close under a valid lease with a lesson. Keep any external submission subject to existing operator authority.

description: I retrieved and read RSL’s November 5 buyer brief. It advertises C$2,000–$2,500 for a remote, six-page WordPress build using Gutenberg and Kadence. The brief invites applications for the full build and provides no basis for a separately priced offline migration QA quote. This finding covers one brief. Reconsider when a live buyer request invites standalone migration or content QA. Commercial feedback has five unclassified sources and no newly interpreted feedback, so demand remains unknown. Treasury remains unfunded with CAD 0 available and CAD 0 verified revenue.
